messages:
maria: kicking off bring-up for atlasx-4b-int8 on dev-staging. plan: run sanity prompt suite, token-diff checks vs fp baseline, smoke load of 5 concurrent requests. posting quick checklist, ping me if blocked
sam: can you paste which model binary and quant config?
maria: using atlasx-4b-q8_256_v2, quant-config: per-channel symmetric, akt-opt. cmd: ```./deploy --model atlasx-4b-q8_256_v2 --env devstg --cache=on```
ben: noted. for sanity prompts i added 50 short prompts (factual QA, code, few-shot). expecting EM > 0.92 vs fp; callouts if >5% drop
amy: saw initial run: sample failure on date normalization prompt — it outputs '23/04/09' instead of '2023-04-09'. attaching minimal log
maria: paste log snippet: ```[WARN] tokenize/detokenize mismatch at step 12
input: 'What is the date today?'
output_q8: '23/04/09'
output_fp: '2023-04-09'```
sam: could be tokenization or detokenization. check tokenizer hash + serving detok code path. which tokenizer hash?
maria: tokenizer sha: 9f8b2c, fp tokenizer sha: 9f8b2c (same). suspect detokenizer step in runtime for certain digit sequences. running detokenizer-only test now
ops-bot: deploy job 2069123460 completed on dev-staging/gpu-pool-3 :white_check_mark:
ben: detokenizer test results: mismatch in byte-level decode for bytes 0xC2 sequence. possible encoding bug in quant-serving runtime. filing issue ML-487 and adding short repro
maria: ok assigning: sam to investigate runtime decode, ben to reproduce minimal repro; amy to collect failing prompt list + exact EM diffs. i'll hold off canary until fixes
sam: ack, will try with alternative runtime flag `--use-utf8-safe-decoder` and post logs
maria: thanks. if that doesn't fix, fallback plan is to try q4_0 instead of q8 for devstg to see if regression disappears
amy: sharing quick stats from initial suite: 50 prompts; avg EM drop 3.8%; 4 critical fails flagged (dates, code token splits, numeric rounding, enum order)
maria: good context. we'll reconvene in ~45m unless someone hits a blocking regression. :thumbsup:
